productOnPage.title: BrainBots Science Fair
productOnPage.author: Yoto
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Shrink down with the BrainBots as they explore the wonders of science and discover its importance in everyday life! Meet the BrainBots: Nellie, Buzz and Gibbs! As these high-tech knowledge gathering robots shrink down to find out as much information as they can before uploading all of their findings to the BrainBank - a big cloud where all that information is stored and shared to kids!In this series, the class are heading to a Science Fair - which means they’ll be learning everything there is to know about science. From forces and magnets, to plants and electricity.Each audio card will take you on a fun fact-filled adventure to learn all about science. Test your knowledge with a quiz to see how many BrainBank facts you can remember and join in with experiments at home by following the special bonus chapter at the end of each card. Tracks included: Chapter 1 Chapter 2 Chapter 3 Chapter 4 Chapter 5 Quiz Experiment
productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
Meet the BrainBots: Nellie, Buzz and Gibbs! As these high-tech knowledge gathering robots shrink down to find out as much information as they can before uploading all of their findings to the BrainBank - a big cloud where all that information is stored and shared to kids!


In this series, the class are heading to a Science Fair - which means they’ll be learning everything there is to know about science. From forces and magnets, to plants and electricity.


Each audio card will take you on a fun fact-filled adventure to learn all about science. Test your knowledge with a quiz to see how many BrainBank facts you can remember and join in with experiments at home by following the special bonus chapter at the end of each card.
productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Shrink down with the BrainBots as they explore the wonders of science and discover its importance in everyday life!._**

Meet the BrainBots: Nellie, Buzz and Gibbs! As these high-tech knowledge gathering robots shrink down to find out as much information as they can before uploading all of their findings to the BrainBank - a big cloud where all that information is stored and shared to kids!  
  
  
  
  
In this series, the class are heading to a Science Fair - which means they’ll be learning everything there is to know about science. From forces and magnets, to plants and electricity.  
  
  
  
  
Each audio card will take you on a fun fact-filled adventure to learn all about science. Test your knowledge with a quiz to see how many BrainBank facts you can remember and join in with experiments at home by following the special bonus chapter at the end of each card.

Tracks included:

*   Chapter 1
*   Chapter 2
*   Chapter 3
*   Chapter 4
*   Chapter 5
*   Quiz
*   Experiment
